purpose: Canonical stabilization ledger for WELP. This record supersedes any earlier stabilization accounting that counted a methodology-validation run as a clean stabilization campaign. Historical campaign reports and closeouts stand as historical evidence and are not rewritten.

superseded_accounting.correction: That run was the METHODOLOGY_VALIDATION for the reasoning-profiles snapshot (a re-derived reuse event plus a first-time sibling profile under a freshly frozen method). Under the corrected rule it is METHODOLOGY_VALIDATION, never clean campaign 1. The corrected count at that baseline is 0/5, not 1.

corrected_rule.methodology_validation_never_counts: The known-model run that validates a newly frozen methodology revision is METHODOLOGY_VALIDATION. It is never clean campaign 1 and never increments the count.
non_inflating_runs: two reasoning profiles of one model
corrected_rule.count_increment_rule: Only a qualifying fresh-model campaign that starts after the freeze under the unchanged frozen method and completes all required profiles and applicable sections increments the count. A negative model verdict can count as clean methodology execution; a campaign requiring a methodology revision cannot.
corrected_rule.minor_fix_exemption: Non-semantic runner/reporting fixes may be recorded separately; changing scoring or experimental meaning is not a minor tooling exemption.
corrected_rule.no_autostart: The first fresh campaign is never started automatically.

current_state.stabilization_baseline: welp-next-snapshot-2026-09-25-reasoning-profiles (historical) -> welp-next-snapshot-2026-09-25-model-agentic (current, set at freeze of the Model/Agentic revision)
current_state.methodology_validation: PENDING (Ling Reasoning Off Agentic validation under the model-agentic snapshot; to be recorded PASS only with real executed evidence)

history.note: Counted run was METHODOLOGY_VALIDATION, not a fresh-model campaign.
